from itertools import permutations

def find_all_interval_series(n):
    target_values = set(range(n))
    target_diffs = set(range(1, n))
    
    for perm in permutations(range(n)):
        diffs = [abs(perm[i+1] - perm[i]) for i in range(n-1)]
        if set(diffs) == target_diffs:
            return perm, diffs
    return None, None

solution, diffs = find_all_interval_series(5)
print(f"Solution: {list(solution)}")
print(f"Consecutive differences: {diffs}")
print(f"Differences set: {set(diffs)} == {{1,2,3,4}}: {set(diffs) == {1,2,3,4}}")
